summary: Runs Google's prompt-rewriting layer over the prompt before generation.
combines: Turning it off gives literal control over the prompt; leaving it on generally improves results from short prompts.
A genuine choice for Lixpi because prompts are already built by our own orchestration.
Documented on Vertex; exposed in GenerateVideosConfig on both surfaces but absent from the Gemini Veo parameter table. Verify against the live API before relying on it.
